messages:
Anya: Quick check-in re: stream retry visibility. We've had incidents where retries were counted as separate user actions in analytics because the frontdoor didn't attach attempt metadata downstream.
Ravi: Proposed: include `x-rw-attempt` and `x-rw-original-id` headers on all retries. Upstream analytics pipeline will dedupe using `original-id`.
Celeste: Where do we generate `original-id`? Gateway at first connect. Keep it stable across all attempts and hedges.
Anya: Also include `retry_reason` in final-event so analytics can classify. Values: `network_error`, `upstream_oom`, `upstream_timeout`, `client_disconnect`.
infra-bot: Reminder: adding headers requires WAF rule update. Staging push at 3:00 UTC.
Ravi: Implementation note: gateway should sign `original-id` to prevent upstream spoofing. Attach `x-rw-original-id-sig` HMAC.
Celeste: Backcompat: if `original-id` absent, treat as new. Old analytics will continue to over-count until all gateways are updated.
Anya: Ok let's coordinate rollout with analytics team. I'll create a tracking ticket.
